name: wanqing-products
description: 晚晴康养产品系列：晚晴·照护（机构版）与 晚晴伴（居家版）

scripts.care:install: npm install --prefix care/service && npm install --prefix care/agent && npm install --prefix care/client
scripts.care: npm run care:preflight && concurrently -n service,agent,gateway,client -c yellow,cyan,green,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run care:service" "npm run care:agent" "npm run care:gateway" "npm run care:client"
scripts.home:install: npm install --prefix home/service && npm install --prefix home/agent && npm install --prefix home/client
scripts.home: npm run home:preflight && concurrently -n service,agent,gateway,client -c yellow,cyan,green,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run home:service" "npm run home:agent" "npm run home:gateway" "npm run home:client"
